problem_summary: 38 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Mangamannapalya between January 2019 and August 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 37% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 19 pothole complaints.
13 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹6.3 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after being marked resolved. This may indicate short-term or superficial repairs that did not address the underlying problem.
agency_attribution_note: 38 of 38 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier HIGH (score=0.63). Top scoring factors: complaint_volume=1.00, recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.37.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Mangamannapalya' matched to datameet243=231 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.647).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Mangamannapalya for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 13 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
